final_message:
No—none of the available tools can look up an "archive-4" record in an external provenance service. The tools I have access to are limited to:

- Episode recall (session history)
- Git operations (commit, diff, status) on repository history
- Repository operations (build, edit, find, read, status)
- Test operations (focus, list, run)

There is no tool for querying external provenance services or archive-related records outside this repository/session context.
